response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CASE WHEN res.laps GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(res.laps AS REAL) END) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.positionOrder >= 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY (avg_laps IS NULL), avg_laps DESC, r.raceId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Toward the back with 12 as the cutoff' is read as positionOrder >= 12, so 12th place is included.
laps is stored as text; non-numeric or empty values are treated as missing and excluded from the average. Ties in the average are broken by raceId.

alternatives.interpretation: Strictly behind the cutoff: positionOrder > 12, so 12th place is excluded.
